summary: The trace reveals a stochastic variant of resource planning that the existing excel-inventory-analysis skill doesn't cover. The task required safety buffer calculations using service-level Z-scores and demand standard deviation (Safety = Z * σ * √days), which modifies the additional-needs formula. The agent also rounded output values (12.73 instead of 12.7272...), violating the precision rule and likely causing the test_legacy_node_checks failure. This patch extends the existing skill with stochastic calculation patterns and reinforces the no-rounding rule.
